name: prosopon
description: Readable transcript layouts with safe stock-renderer fallbacks.

labels.title: Frame labels
labels.description: Language of the frame titles: en (You) or fr (Vous). Any other value uses en.

user_label.title: Your frame label
user_label.description: Optional title for your prompt frame. Up to 20 code points with no control characters; invalid values use the language label.

user_color.title: Your frame color
user_color.description: A color name (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta, pink, gray, grey, white, black), a Claude Code theme color, or #rrggbb. Invalid values use suggestion.

assistant_color.title: Assistant frame color
assistant_color.description: A color name (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta, pink, gray, grey, white, black), a Claude Code theme color, or #rrggbb. Invalid values use claude.
